Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
This is a general issue with the latest version of Joomla (3.8.4). Thousands of components (such as the VEKN component) are impacted.

This will be reverted in the next version (in a few days hopefully) and everything should work again. Until then, please wait to create events, players, or to submit archons.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
